scenarios.magnitude: post-hoc reading drift to +1.0 C (BuildStream v1.0 injector)
scenarios.observation: Since July 2018 the reported temperature of the Core_mid zone (Zone_F3_Z01) has risen relative to the other zones. The reported zone temperature comes from a monitoring sensor. The zone's controller uses its own thermostat, which is not in the data.
